description: Per-mode calendar relevance configuration (NIC-126). `modeProfiles` maps each mode to the `calendarProfile` its dashboard resolves live schedule by (the same values the mode configs carry). `defaultMode` is where an event lands when it has neither a `#[mode]` tag in its notes nor a mapped calendar — Executive, whose profile `all` is the catch-all that shows every event. `tagAliases` are the `#[mode]` tag tokens a user (or the future create-event tool) can write in an event's description; a raw mode id (e.g. `#developer`) also resolves directly. Source configuration lives here, not hardcoded in the resolver (FR-CFG).
